# Marigold

> Modern Indian restaurant in Eastchester, New York, led by Chef-Entrepreneur Ravi. Regional Indian cooking with a modern hand: tandoori, biryanis, curries, handcrafted cocktails, happy hour, catering and private parties.

## Visit
- Address: 434 White Plains Rd, Eastchester, NY 10709
- Phone: (914) 202-9455
- Catering & private parties: (347) 400-5094
- Email: info@marigold.restaurant
- Directions: https://maps.app.goo.gl/9gMnFGn18CvkTb8K8
- Hours: Mon–Thu 11:30 AM–3 PM and 4:30–10 PM; Fri–Sat 11:30 AM–10 PM; Sun 11:30 AM–9:30 PM

## Reserve and order
- Reserve on Resy: https://resy.com/cities/eastchester-ny-ny/venues/marigold
- Reserve on Yelp: https://www.yelp.com/reservations/marigold-eastchester
- Order online (pickup and delivery): https://www.ordermarigoldrestaurant.com/

## Specials
- Happy hour: Monday to Thursday, 4:30–7 PM. $7 appetizers; cocktails, beer and wine half price.
- Weekend early bird: Saturday & Sunday, 11:30 AM–3 PM. Three courses with a champagne toast, $40.
- Lunch: choice of one entrée served with rice, dal & naan, from $15.

## Signature dishes
Samosa trio, pani puri shots, beet arancini, mango coconut shrimp, achari chicken tikka, tandoori chicken, lamb chops, tandoori shrimp, butter chicken, Chettinad chicken, goat rogan josh, seafood curry, chicken / vegetable / goat biryani, naan, paneer kundan kalia, paneer-stuffed portobello, masala eggplant, dal makhani.

## Catering and private parties
Full-service catering (setup, serving, clean-up, staff) and drop-off catering for weddings, corporate events, holiday gatherings, birthdays, anniversaries, social and community events. Private parties from a semi-private section to the entire dining room, with plated, buffet or family-style menus and full beverage service.

## Dietary
Vegetarian section on the menu; vegan and gluten-free options available. Dual pricing applies to card and cash payments.

## Press and reviews
- Featured in Forbes (John Mariani, December 2024).
- 4.9 stars from 1,425 Google reviews.
